title: Aviary caller-supplied GEO crawler IP ranges
description: Offline CIDR ranges supplied by the operator for comparing logged source addresses with recognized crawler user-agent claims. Ranges are not fetched or authenticated by Aviary and must be maintained by the operator.

token.description: A built-in crawler token or a token also supplied with --geo-crawler-token.

items.description: Strict IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR; runtime validation rejects hostnames, zone identifiers, and unsupported forms.
